Text.Text: I'm Sergeant Halden Prax of the Republic garrison. We were posted here to protect the colony from the Sith, but it's the wildlife doing the damage. I have paid work if you want it.
Good work. Here is your Republic pay. It isn't much, but it always arrives on time.
You're back, and my supply runners say nothing chased them today. Did you kill all ten Iriaz?

The farmers keep tame Iriaz, but the wild herds gore anyone who walks through the grass, and my supply runners are getting hurt. I need you to kill ten Iriaz. You'll find them in the Forsaken Jungles, by the Lake and in the Canyon Crystal Fields. Come back to me here on the Wild Plains when it's done and I'll pay you.
Good. Kill ten Iriaz in the Forsaken Jungles, by the Lake or in the Canyon Crystal Fields on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Iriaz in the Forsaken Jungles, by the Lake or in the Canyon Crystal Fields on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
That buys the colony a quiet season. Here is your pay, with hazard pay on top.
You're back, and the web line has pulled away from the trail. Did you kill all twelve Hive Kinrath?

Hive Kinrath used to stay inside the Kinrath Caves. Now they have spread into the Forsaken Jungles, and one of their web lines has reached the trail. I need you to kill twelve Hive Kinrath, in the caves or in the jungles, before the hive decides the colony is food. Report back to me here when it's done.
Good. Kill twelve Hive Kinrath in the Kinrath Caves or the Forsaken Jungles on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
Yes, there is a queen, and someone has dealt with her before. The hive just keeps breeding more Kinrath, so thinning them out is the best we can do.
You still need to kill twelve Hive Kinrath in the Kinrath Caves or the Forsaken Jungles on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
Thank you. They'll breed back soon enough, but the stores are safe for now. Here is your pay.
Welcome back. My ration crate count matched this morning, for once. Did you kill all fifteen Gizka?

Gizka are the smallest problem I have, and there are more of them than anything else. They ate the farmlands down to dirt, now they are into our stores, and on this world they bite. I need you to kill fifteen Gizka in the Ruined Farmlands, the Forsaken Jungles or the Janta Caves, then come back to me for your pay.
Good. Kill fifteen Gizka in the Ruined Farmlands, the Forsaken Jungles or the Janta Caves on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill fifteen Gizka in the Ruined Farmlands, the Forsaken Jungles or the Janta Caves on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
Good. The farmers wanted to pay you in turnips, but I talked them into real pay. If you want more work, ask me why the herds keep coming back.
You're back, and the farmers are out with their ploughs again. Did you kill all ten Plains Thune?

A herd of Plains Thune came through the Ruined Farmlands and never left. The farmers want to replant, and they can't do it with a ton of Thune standing on every seedbed. I need you to go to the Ruined Farmlands and kill ten Plains Thune. Come back to me when it's done and I'll see you paid.
Good. Kill ten Plains Thune in the Ruined Farmlands on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Plains Thune in the Ruined Farmlands on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
Well done. Here is a garrison bonus. I had to fill in a form in triplicate to get it for you.
You're back, and my scouts say three herds have turned north, away from the colony. Did you kill all three Herd Leader Thune?

Every herd follows one old Thune, and wherever that leader charges, the rest charge with it. Kill the leaders and the herds forget where the farms are. I need you to kill three Herd Leader Thune. They lead herds in the Ruined Farmlands, in the Forsaken Jungles and by the Lake. Come back to me when all three are dead.
Good. Kill three Herd Leader Thune in the Ruined Farmlands, the Forsaken Jungles or by the Lake on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill three Herd Leader Thune in the Ruined Farmlands, the Forsaken Jungles or by the Lake on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
The Herd Leader Thune are next, but first finish killing the Plains Thune in the Ruined Farmlands. Come back to me when that job is done.
Good. Here is the patrol rate. The work is open again whenever you have the time.
You're back from the grass. Did you finish the patrol and kill ten Iriaz and ten Gizka?

It does, as standing work, because my troopers are needed on the wall. A patrol means killing ten Iriaz and ten Gizka anywhere on Dantooine. The Forsaken Jungles have plenty of both. Come back to me here when you have killed all twenty and you draw the patrol rate, as often as you care to do it.
Good. Kill ten Iriaz and ten Gizka on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Iriaz and ten Gizka on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
Thank you. This comes from the ration fund. The troopers will never know your name, but they will eat well because of you.
These are good, heavy cuts, and the mess sergeant nearly cried. Is that all eight Thune Meat?

Badly. The Gizka got half our rations, and I have forty troopers and one week of food. One Thune feeds a squad for days. I need you to hunt the Thune of Dantooine and bring me eight Thune Meat. Hand them to me here and nobody in the garrison goes on half rations.
Good. Bring me eight Thune Meat. You can get them from the Thune of Dantooine.
I still need eight Thune Meat. You can get them from the Thune of Dantooine. Bring them to me when you have them all.
Goodbye, Sergeant. Hold the line.
What other work do you have for me?
Yes, all ten Iriaz are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I'll kill ten Iriaz for you.
Not right now, Sergeant.
Which animals are attacking the colonists?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Iriaz.
Yes, all twelve Hive Kinrath are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job and kill twelve Hive Kinrath.
No, I don't go near Kinrath hives.
Does the hive have a queen?
What is coming out of the Kinrath Caves?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Hive Kinrath.
Yes, all fifteen Gizka are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
All right, I'll kill fifteen Gizka for you.
No thanks, Gizka seem harmless to me.
What is eating the garrison's stores?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Gizka.
Yes, all ten Plains Thune are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. Ten Plains Thune in the Ruined Farmlands.
Not right now. I'm not a herder.
What flattened the farms out here?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Plains Thune.
Yes, all three Herd Leader Thune are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take it. I'll kill three Herd Leader Thune.
No, those are too big for me.
Why do the Thune herds keep coming back?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Herd Leader Thune.
What will you do about the herds after the stampede?
Yes, I killed ten of each.
I will come back.
On my way.
Yes, I'll walk a patrol. Ten Iriaz and ten Gizka.
Not today, Sergeant. Maybe another time.
Does the garrison pay for patrols of the plains?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the plains patrol involves.
Yes, that's all eight Thune Meat.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you eight Thune Meat.
No, put in a requisition for it.
How are the garrison's rations holding up?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me what you need for the garrison's rations.
